scenes.vo: She swiped left because of THIS.
Most guys look two inches shorter just from poor posture.
Fix how you carry yourself in three simple daily moves.
Number one: wall slides to pull your rounded shoulders back.
Number two: cobra stretches to decompress tight spinal joints.
Number three: daily core planks so your spine holds upright effortlessly.
And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.
